subject: One main-repo check for both dispatch paths (HEAD / push / porcelain / hard_block.dirs) replaces the #127 attribution guard; auto-fix.sh shrinks
objective: Per D-064 as confirmed by D-065 (1)(2) and the main-line calls D-065 Q3-Q5: four before/after comparisons - main HEAD, origin refs, main-repo working tree (porcelain + content hash of dirty files), files under hard_block.dirs - live in one shared module and run for both the headless rounds (auto-fix exit 8 as today) and the 'auto-fix.sh --prepare' in-session subagent rounds (apply.sh exit 7 on receipt). No per-commit attribution: HEAD moving forward while a main-line land event happened in the window is recorded, not blocked, and the record lists the commits in the window that belong to no land event (set difference, no chain walk; D-065 (1)). Working-tree changes under tickets/ docs/ memory/ are recorded, not blocked, but a path on board/config.json hard_block.paths (docs/DECISIONS.md, docs/VISION.md, ...) is never exempt - dirty in the working tree or changed by a commit in the window (D-065 (2)). The #127 chain walk and the #144 local-branch check go; round-1 setup shared by --prepare and the headless first round exists once; scripts/auto-fix.sh ends smaller than base (goal: below 2,959, D-063 6).
acceptance: A1 One shared Python module under scripts/ (name chosen by the worker, listed in EVIDENCE) holds the whole check: 'snapshot' (ts; main HEAD 40 hex; 'git status --porcelain=v1 -z --untracked-files=all' of the main repo with a content hash per listed path; every file under board/config.json hard_block.dirs (~ expanded, relative to the main repo) with its hash; 'git ls-remote origin' refs, bounded by a timeout) and 'compare' (snapshot vs now). It is the only copy: scripts/auto-fix.sh and scripts/apply.sh call it and contain no porcelain walk, hard_block.dirs walk or ls-remote of their own.

A2 Compare rules. (a) HEAD unchanged -> ok. HEAD moved forward (snapshot HEAD is an ancestor of current main) AND the events file has at least one land.pass, or land.fail with stage=push, whose ts is at or after the snapshot ts -> recorded, not blocked (D-065 (1), user-confirmed). The record names old..new short shas, the land stamps, and the NON-LAND COMMITS: 'git rev-list old..new' minus the union, over those in-window land events, of 'git rev-list <main_before>..<sha>' (the event's own range; the event's sha alone when it has no main_before). This is a set difference over each event's own fields - no chain walk, no segment joining, no per-commit verdict; a non-land commit never turns the record into a reject (D-065 (1): '不擋，只要查得到'). Each non-land commit is listed by short sha + subject; when there are none the record says so ('non-land commits: none'). Exception (a'): when 'git diff --name-only old new' names a path matching board/config.json hard_block.paths (same matcher as land.sh: ticket.py hard_block / first_match) -> reject, land events or not (D-065 (2) '有變就拒收' and its stated consequence that the main line cannot change docs/DECISIONS.md while a round runs). HEAD moved with no such event, or snapshot HEAD no longer an ancestor of main (reset / rewrite) -> reject. (b) origin: any remote ref created / moved / deleted -> reject, except refs/heads/main (and the HEAD symref) moving when (a) found a land event in the window. No 'origin' remote -> not compared, one line. 'git ls-remote' failing or timing out at either end -> one line 'push not compared', not a rejection (D-065 Q4). Other local branches (refs/heads/* of the main repo) are not compared (D-065 Q3; #144 check removed). (c) working tree: a path whose porcelain status or hash differs -> reject, except the control plane (tickets / events / answers / reports as config resolves them, as today), the agent's own worktree / copy, and paths under guard_main_paths prefixes (default tickets/ docs/ memory/) which are recorded, not blocked (#128 A1 kept, D-065 (2)). A path matching board/config.json hard_block.paths is NEVER exempt, whichever prefix it sits under: docs/DECISIONS.md or docs/VISION.md created / changed / deleted / dirtied again -> reject (D-065 (2)). (d) hard_block.dirs: any file created / changed / deleted -> reject, no exception, land events or not.

A3 Prepared path: 'auto-fix.sh <n> --prepare worker|verifier' writes the snapshot to '<round dir>/main-snapshot.json' (fix-t<n>/round1, verify-t<n>/round1) before printing the pointer; the pointer (fd 3 / stdout) is unchanged - extra messages go to stderr; no origin or unreachable origin does not fail prepare. apply.sh compares every main-snapshot.json it finds (worker: the round dir; verifier: the patch-verify's directory); any reject -> new exit code 7 BEFORE applying patch-verify, regenerating code-map or harvesting EVIDENCE (ticket JSON bytes and ticket branch head unchanged); stderr names the first offending item (sha range, ref or path) and says 'not received'. Recorded items -> one stdout line each, rc as base. The same record (recorded items incl. the non-land commit list, or the reject) is also written as JSON to 'main-compare.json' next to the main-snapshot.json it compared, so it can be looked up after the conversation (D-065 (1) '查得到').

A4 No main-snapshot.json (hand-dispatched subagent, apply calls from headless rounds) -> apply prints one line that the main-repo comparison was not made and keeps its base behaviour and rc (D-065 Q5: hand-dispatched subagents are not compared).

A5 Headless path: run_agent snapshots before each worker / verifier / batch-worker process and compares after it exits with the same module. A reject keeps today's outcome: auto-fix exit 8, ticket Blocked, owner main, attempt.failed reason=guard-violation, one decision page naming the items; the per-agent '<log stem>.guard.json' keeps its name and its 'violations' / 'main_side' keys so kept cases read it unchanged; a recorded HEAD move writes guard.json (rc unchanged) and its 'notes' carry the A2(a) record line incl. every non-land commit's short sha. Removed: the land_rows / land_segments / land_attribution chain walk (#127, #128 A4) and the refs/heads comparison of other local branches (#144): grep -rn 'land_attribution\|land_segments\|land_rows' scripts/ returns nothing.

A6 Shared setup exists once: prepare_worker and round_once's first round call one helper for round dir + first_round_packet + ticket worktree + Ready->Running; prepare_verifier and the headless verifier start call one helper for source choice + archive_copy + verifier_packet.

A7 Size: 'wc -l < scripts/auto-fix.sh' on the branch head < 3414 (base 277cf56, measured). Goal <= 2958 (D-063 6); if above, EVIDENCE says why in one sentence (D-064: '沒到的話，報告寫一句理由就好'). EVIDENCE records before/after wc -l of scripts/auto-fix.sh, scripts/apply.sh and the module. Comments narrating superseded history may go; comments giving a current reason stay.

A8 Cases that only pinned removed behaviour are deleted, not skipped (D-057 1), and listed in EVIDENCE: the attribution / chain / local-branch / land-segment verdict cases in tests/test_auto_fix.py TheGuardCatchesAgentsOutsideTheirCopy (e.g. test_127_a4_a_bare_commit_before_a_legal_land_is_named, test_127_a5_*, test_144_another_branch_moved_*, test_128_a4_*segment) and in verify/dispatch/test_ticket_115/127/128.py (whole file when nothing is left). Cases on land.sh's event shape stay green unchanged (land.sh is not changed): tests/test_land.py, verify/dispatch/test_ticket_127.py A1*, verify/dispatch/test_ticket_129.py A7. Cases on kept behaviour (porcelain incl. dirty-again hash, control plane, hard_block.dirs incl. ~ expansion, guard_main_paths prefixes, serial verifier guarded, a concurrent land, a land.start alone does not excuse a HEAD move) stay green with assertions unchanged. Cases REVERSED by D-065 (2) (measured: tests/control_harness.py DEFAULT_CONFIG hard_block.paths lists docs/DECISIONS.md and docs/VISION.md): tests/test_auto_fix.py test_128_a1_main_paths_are_recorded_not_stopped subtests '修改' and '已髒檔再改' and verify/dispatch/test_ticket_128.py test_a1_modify_delete_and_dirty_again_under_docs write docs/DECISIONS.md and assert it is recorded - they go red by design. Fix: switch those writes to a docs/ path NOT on hard_block.paths (e.g. docs/NOTES.md / a new docs file) with assertions otherwise unchanged; the DECISIONS.md reject is pinned by the new T7b cases. List the edited cases in EVIDENCE.

A9 Docs follow: apply.sh header lists exit 7; auto-fix.sh header's exit 8 text states the four comparisons without attribution; docs/WORKFLOW.md item 8 (agent guard) and docs/DISPATCH-TEMPLATE.md lines naming refs/heads or attribution say the D-064 rule; docs/SESSION-START.md main-line dispatch line lists apply rc 7 with what the main line does (do not hand the round back to the subagent; read the named item and decide). docs/WORKFLOW.md item 8 and docs/SESSION-START.md also state D-065 (2)'s consequence: while a dispatched round runs, the main line does not edit or land files on hard_block.paths (docs/DECISIONS.md, docs/VISION.md) - doing so rejects the round.
A10 As uid 0: 'python3 -m unittest discover -s tests' and 'python3 scripts/verify.py' are green; EVIDENCE records Ran counts and rc.
feature: Dispatch: one main-repo check for headless and --prepare rounds (D-064)
test_plan:
Expected values come from the fixture's own git / file operations (the test makes the commits, pushes and writes and knows their shas and paths) and from D-064's wording, never from the code under test. Layer: end-to-end through scripts/auto-fix.sh (--prepare and headless), scripts/apply.sh and the real 'sh scripts/land.sh docs' where named, in the existing tests/test_auto_fix.py fixtures (APreparedRoundIsHandedInByAnInSessionSubagent for the prepared path, TheGuardCatchesAgentsOutsideTheirCopy for headless). Cases go into those existing modules (D-056: no new ticket-numbered case files); verify.tags empty. Root (uid 0) safe: no chmod / mode-bit injection; 'origin' is a local bare repo made by the test; no network. New test lines must not contain the hard_block patterns (os.kill, killpg, pkill, 'kill -').

T1 (A3) prepare -> nothing moves -> apply rc 0; existing prepared-round cases green.
T2 (A2a) prepare -> the test runs 'sh scripts/land.sh docs "<msg>" tickets/<n>.json' once, then twice -> apply rc 0; stdout has the recorded line with the snapshot HEAD and current HEAD short shas and 'non-land commits: none' (both commits are the landings' own shas, read by the test with 'git rev-parse main' after each landing); main-compare.json beside the snapshot holds the same record; patch-verify commit on the branch as before.
T3 (A2a/A3) prepare -> 'git -C <root> commit --allow-empty -m stray' on main, no land events -> rc 7; stderr has 'not received' and the snapshot HEAD short sha; ticket JSON bytes and ticket branch head equal their values read before apply.
T4 (A2a, D-064/D-065 (1) reversal of #127 A4) prepare -> 'git -C <root> commit --allow-empty -m stray' (test records its sha S), then a docs landing (test records its sha L) -> rc 0; the recorded line lists S as a non-land commit (short sha + 'stray') and does not list L; main-compare.json lists S. Variant: two stray commits S1, S2 before the landing -> both listed, rc 0.
T5 (A2a) 'git -C <root> reset --hard HEAD~1' after prepare -> rc 7.
T6 (A2b) fixture with a bare origin (main pushed before prepare): (a) 'git -C <worktree> push origin t<n>' -> rc 7 naming refs/heads/t<n>; (b) a docs landing (land.sh pushes main) -> rc 0; (c) 'git -C <worktree> push --force origin <ticket branch head>:refs/heads/main' (a sha not on local main) with no land event -> rc 7 naming refs/heads/main; (d) 'git remote set-url origin <missing path>' after prepare -> rc as base and a 'push not compared' line (D-065 Q4); (e) a local branch other than the ticket branch created / moved in the main repo after prepare (git -C <root> branch zz HEAD~1) -> rc as base, no line about it (D-065 Q3). No origin at all -> prepare rc 0, apply rc 0 with the not-compared line.
T7 (A2c) prepare, then in the main repo: untracked scripts/stray.txt -> rc 7 naming it; a file already dirty before prepare written again -> rc 7; docs/stray.md -> rc 0 + recorded line; memory/stray.md -> rc 0 + recorded line; 'ticket.py set <other ticket> …' -> rc 0.
T7b (A2c, D-065 (2)) fixture board/config.json hard_block.paths contains docs/DECISIONS.md and docs/VISION.md (as the real config). prepare, then: (i) append a line to docs/DECISIONS.md in the main repo working tree -> rc 7, stderr names docs/DECISIONS.md and 'not received'; (ii) same for docs/VISION.md -> rc 7; (iii) docs/DECISIONS.md already dirty before prepare and written again -> rc 7; (iv) control: docs/other.md changed in the same window -> rc 0 + recorded line. Headless twin (A5, TheGuardCatchesAgentsOutsideTheirCopy fixture): fake worker appends to <root>/docs/DECISIONS.md -> exit 8, guard.json 'violations' names it. The reversed #128 A1 subtests (A8) run green with their DECISIONS.md writes moved to a non-hard_block docs path.
T7c (A2a', D-065 (2)) prepare, then the test edits docs/DECISIONS.md and lands it with 'sh scripts/land.sh docs "<msg>" docs/DECISIONS.md' (main-line identity, porcelain clean before and after) -> rc 7 naming docs/DECISIONS.md; control: same with docs/other.md -> rc 0 + recorded line.
T8 (A2d) config hard_block.dirs = [a temp dir outside the repo] with one file; change it after prepare -> rc 7; same change plus a docs landing in the window -> still rc 7.
T9 (A3) after prepare: fix-t<n>/round1/main-snapshot.json and verify-t<n>/round1/main-snapshot.json exist, their HEAD equals 'git rev-parse main' taken by the test before prepare; existing pointer assertions of the two prepare classes stay green unchanged.
T10 (A4, D-065 Q5) delete main-snapshot.json before apply -> rc 0 and the not-compared line; no main-compare.json written.
T11 (A5) headless, existing guard fixture: fake worker commits on main (no land) -> exit 8, Blocked, owner main, one page; fake worker writes under hard_block.dirs -> exit 8; fake worker commits only on its branch while the test runs a docs landing -> received as before, guard.json 'notes' has the recorded line with 'non-land commits: none'; fake worker commits on main (sha S, read by the test) and the test then runs a docs landing -> not exit 8, guard.json 'notes' lists S as a non-land commit. Kept guard cases run unchanged.
T12 (A1/A5) grep -rn 'land_attribution\|land_segments\|land_rows' scripts/ -> empty; grep -c 'ls-remote' scripts/auto-fix.sh scripts/apply.sh -> 0 each; the module has it.
T13 (A6) grep: first_round_packet has one caller inside the shared helper; archive_copy + verifier_packet appear once in sequence.
T14 (A7) wc -l before/after in EVIDENCE.
T15 (A8/A10) full suite as uid 0 in batches under 590 s each; EVIDENCE lists deleted cases.
Mutations (not measured by the opener): M1 replace the land-event window with literal HEAD equality -> T2 red. M2 skip the remote comparison -> T6a red. M3 run the check after the patch-verify commit -> T3 'branch head unchanged' red. M4 exempt hard_block.dirs when a land is in the window -> T8 second half red. M5 restore per-commit attribution (a non-land commit rejects) -> T4 red. M6 drop the non-land commit list from the record -> T4 and T11 last case red. M7 let guard_main_paths prefixes exempt hard_block.paths (DECISIONS.md under docs/) -> T7b (i) red. M8 drop the hard_block.paths check on old..new -> T7c red.
outline: Merged #153 + #154 (D-064). Rule = D-064 main-line reading, confirmed by the user in D-065 (1): four comparisons in one module for both paths; HEAD forward + land event in window = record, and the record lists commits in the window outside every in-window land event's own main_before..sha range (set difference, no chain). D-065 (2): tickets/ docs/ memory/ changes recorded; hard_block.paths (DECISIONS.md, VISION.md, sync-to-project.sh) never exempt - opener reads '有變' as working tree AND committed in old..new (A2a'), else the main line could edit+land DECISIONS.md inside a window unseen. D-065 Q3-Q5 (main-line calls): #144 dropped, ls-remote failure prints only, no snapshot = not compared. Why merged: one edit of auto-fix.sh; split = two workers on a 3.4k-line file. #154 Cancelled. Measured: auto-fix.sh 3414 @277cf56 and @2181c82; guard+chain 1347-1660 + guard_stop 398-447; land.pass sha is short, main_before full; ticket landings are ff-only with main_before=LAND_BASE. Estimate ~2,960 (not measured). Touches: auto-fix.sh, apply.sh, new module, tests/test_auto_fix.py, verify/dispatch/test_ticket_115/127/128.py, WORKFLOW 8, DISPATCH-TEMPLATE, SESSION-START. land.sh, sync-to-project.sh (D-065 (3), user on Mac) unchanged. Reversed by D-065 (2): #128 A1 subtests that record docs/DECISIONS.md (A8 names them). Depends #152. complex; needs_verifier=true (new receipt contract).
